errors.text_span: 图表显示了在Twitter数据集上，基于语义任务辅助的方面情感分析模型（F1）和准确率（Acc）的表现，以捕捉句法依存距离为变量进行比较。图表的x轴标记为“captured_distance”，刻度是线性的，数值范围从1到8，单位是整数。刻度间隔为1，在1点附近，线表示68%；在8点附近，线表示74%。图表中的一条红色线条，标记为“F1”，用实线表示，从大约68%开始，在1到5之间持稳定状态，在5点附近达到大约78%，然后下降到大约76%；一条蓝色线条，标记为“Acc”，用实线表示，从大约76%开始，在1到5之间下降到大约74%，然后上升到大约78%。
errors.evidence: The entire description is structured as a single, long run-on sentence connected by commas and semicolons, rather than a coherent paragraph of distinct sentences as requested by the prompt. For example, '单位是整数。刻度间隔为1...' is grammatically incorrect and impairs readability.

This description for the F1 line is ambiguous. The line drops after x=6, reaching approximately 76.6% at x=7 and ending at approximately 75.9% at x=8. Stating it drops 'to about 76%' does not clearly specify the endpoint of the drop.
